name: Oil (Brent)
summary: Brent near $95.6 on 13 Nov, up 3% on the week but 13% lower on the month; Hormuz still restricted
state: Brent was near $95.6 early on 13 Nov, 3.3% higher on the week but 13% lower over a month, inside the $85–110 Watch band (Yahoo Finance). Prices fell in the week to 9 Nov on hopes for US–Iran talks, then rose from about $91.7 on 11 Nov as reports of tankers hit in Hormuz kept supply concerns alive (Euronews). No new outage above 2 mb/d was confirmed this run.
for_you: Fuel prices tend to follow Brent with a lag of a few weeks; supply through Hormuz remains disrupted, so prices are sensitive to news from the Gulf.

sources.title: Euronews — Oil prices rise as investors monitor shipping disruption in the Strait of Hormuz

why: Oil feeds inflation, transport and household budgets; price spikes have preceded most post-war recessions.
drivers: OPEC+ output, Middle East supply risk, sanctions, demand, inventories, shipping disruption.

rubric.alert: Brent > $110, or 1-month change > +30%, or a major physical supply outage (> 2 mb/d).
